name: Woodland Pathways' Programme of Woodland Sessions
whoFor: Adults in Kirklees who want to improve wellbeing, build confidence, reconnect with others and take small steps towards future opportunities. Particularly helpful for people with low confidence, anxiety, health conditions, caring responsibilities, or who feel stuck or unsure of next steps.
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK

projects.name: Woodland Pathways Programme
projects.overview: A gentle, creative outdoor programme with shared food around the campfire and hands-on activities such as willow weaving, greenwood work, seasonal crafts and small woodland maintenance tasks. People join in as much or as little as they like. The team includes an Occupational Therapist who gives guidance on wellbeing, confidence and next steps. Suited to people who don't feel comfortable in formal settings.
projects.duration: 5 weekly sessions of 4 hours per cohort (3 cohorts, 15 sessions in total)
where: Eden's Forest CIC, Hey Wood, Hall Ing, Honley, HD9 - near Honley train station

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - grant-funded project (status not stated in the pathways document)
